sentences.en: If you want to run your mouth, we can be two consenting adults.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在这里解决。

sentences.en: We can finish it here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那很好。

sentences.en: Okay, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 完美。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 你想现在就来吗？

sentences.en: You want to do it now?
sentences.zh: 我很乐意现在就来。

sentences.en: I'd love to do it right now.
sentences.zh: 那就站起来。

sentences.en: Well, stand your butt up then.
sentences.zh: 你站起来。

sentences.en: You stand your butt up.
sentences.zh: 哦，等等。

sentences.en: Oh, hold on.
sentences.zh: 哦，住手。

sentences.en: Oh, stop it.
sentences.zh: 哦，住手。

sentences.en: Is that your solution?
sentences.zh: 这就是你的解决方案吗？

sentences.en: I've repulled it.
sentences.zh: 我已经重新拉取了。

sentences.en: No, no, sit down.
sentences.zh: 不，不，坐下。

sentences.en: During a hearing before Congress.
sentences.zh: 在国会听证会期间。

sentences.en: Yeah, during a hearing before Congress.
sentences.zh: 没错，在国会听证会期间。

sentences.en: No, I have the button.
sentences.zh: 不，按钮在我这儿。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: This is what he said.
sentences.zh: 这就是他所说的。

sentences.en: Can I respond?
sentences.zh: 我可以回应吗？

sentences.en: No, you can't.
sentences.zh: 不，你不能。

sentences.en: This is a hearing.
sentences.zh: 这是一场听证会。

sentences.en: And God knows the American people have enough contempt for Congress.
sentences.zh: 天知道美国人民对国会已经够蔑视的了。

sentences.en: Let's not make it worse.
sentences.zh: 我们别让情况变得更糟了。

sentences.en: I don't like thugs and bullies.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢暴徒和恶霸。

sentences.en: I don't like you.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢你。

sentences.en: He's somebody who doesn't shy away from a fight.
sentences.zh: 他是一个不畏惧冲突的人。

sentences.en: He's willing to go back and forth with reporters, with other politicians.
sentences.zh: 他愿意与记者和其他政客针锋相对。

sentences.en: And I think Trump likes that.
sentences.zh: 我想特朗普喜欢这一点。

sentences.en: And he perhaps wants that from someone who's leading this massive law enforcement agency.
sentences.zh: 而且他或许希望由一个领导这个庞大执法机构的人来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So overall, Mullen is a stick-to-your-guns kind of appointment over at DHS.
sentences.zh: 所以总的来说，马伦是国土安全部那种坚持己见的任命人选。

sentences.en: And rather than this being a referendum on the ways in which immigration enforcement under Noem has worked,
sentences.zh: 与其说这是对诺姆领导下的移民执法方式的公投，

sentences.en: this really, at the end of the day, is only a referendum on Kristi Noem herself.
sentences.zh: 倒不如说，归根结底，这只是对克里斯蒂·诺姆本人的一次公投。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think so.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也这么认为。

sentences.en: And I think perhaps there is some expectation that without some of this drama, without some of these scandals,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，或许人们有一种期待，即如果没有这些闹剧，没有这些丑闻，

sentences.en: that maybe Mullen can be more effective in following through with this deportation agenda,
sentences.zh: 马伦也许能更有效地推进这项驱逐议程，

sentences.en: really in the face of all this polling that shows that Americans are starting to get disgusted by what they're seeing on the streets.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在所有民调都显示美国人开始对街头所见感到厌恶的情况下。

sentences.en: Trump hasn't backed away from any of that.
sentences.zh: 特朗普并没有在这些问题上退缩。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's going to be on Mullen to pick this up and see this aggressive and at times unpopular campaign through for its next chapter.
sentences.zh: 所以，马伦将肩负重任，接手并推动这场激进且有时不受欢迎的运动进入下一个篇章。

sentences.en: Well, Hamid, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，哈米德，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 感激不尽。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, Democrats in Congress said that Noem's firing would not change their plans to keep the Homeland Security Department defunded
sentences.zh: 周四下午，国会民主党人表示，诺姆的解职不会改变他们继续停止国土安全部拨款的计划，

sentences.en: until they see major reforms across the agency.
sentences.zh: 直到他们看到该机构进行重大改革。

sentences.en: Meanwhile...
sentences.zh: 与此同时……

sentences.en: Hey, Kristi Noem, don't let the door hit you on the way out.
sentences.zh: 嘿，克里斯蒂·诺姆，走的时候别让门撞到你。

sentences.en: Several of the party's leaders openly celebrated Noem's ouster.
sentences.zh: 该党的多位领导人公开庆祝诺姆的下台。

sentences.en: Governor J.B.
sentences.zh: 伊利诺伊州州长J.B.

sentences.en: Pritzker of Illinois, a loud critic of Noem's immigration tactics in his state,
sentences.zh: 普利兹克，作为诺姆在其州内移民策略的强烈批评者，

sentences.en: warned Noem that leaving the job would not absolve her from blame.
sentences.zh: 警告诺姆说，离职并不能免除她的罪责。

sentences.en: Here's your legacy.
sentences.zh: 这就是你的遗产。

sentences.en: Corruption and chaos.
sentences.zh: 腐败与混乱。

sentences.en: Parents and children tear-gassed.
sentences.zh: 父母和孩子被催泪瓦斯攻击。

sentences.en: Moms and nurses.
sentences.zh: 母亲和护士们。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: citizens getting shot in the face.
sentences.zh: 公民被射中面部。

sentences.en: Now that you're gone, don't think you get to just walk away.
sentences.zh: 既然你已经走了，别以为你可以就这样一走了之。

sentences.en: I guarantee you, you will still be held accountable.
sentences.zh: 我向你保证，你仍会被追究责任。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周四下午，美国

sentences.en: House of Representatives blocked a bipartisan measure that sought to rein in President Trump's ability to continue the war in Iran without congressional approval.
sentences.zh: 众议院否决了一项两党措施，该措施旨在限制特朗普总统在未经国会批准的情况下继续在伊朗发动战争的能力。

sentences.en: Because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 由于美国

sentences.en: Senate had blocked a similar measure a day earlier,
sentences.zh: 参议院前一天否决了类似的措施，

sentences.en: Trump now faces no constraints on his ability to wage the war.
sentences.zh: 特朗普现在在发动战争的能力上不受任何约束。

sentences.en: In Europe, Britain and Italy accelerated their deployment of military equipment and personnel to protect their citizens and infrastructure in the Middle East,
sentences.zh: 在欧洲，英国和意大利加快了军事装备和人员的部署，以保护其在中东的公民和基础设施，

sentences.en: as the war continued to spill out beyond the region.
sentences.zh: 因为战争继续蔓延到该地区之外。

sentences.en: For many European governments, the deployments are occurring despite their skepticism of the war.
sentences.zh: 对于许多欧洲政府来说，尽管他们对这场战争持怀疑态度，但部署仍在进行。

sentences.en: While the region has been plunged into chaos,
sentences.zh: 虽然该地区已陷入混乱，

sentences.en: my focus is providing calm, level-headed leadership in the national intereSt.
sentences.zh: 我的重点是出于国家利益，提供冷静、理智的领导。

sentences.en: During a news conference on Thursday, British Prime Minister Keir Starmer reaffirmed his decision
sentences.zh: 在周四的新闻发布会上，英国首相基尔·斯塔默重申了他的决定，

sentences.en: not to participate in the attack against Iran, even if it upsets the United States.
sentences.zh: 即不参与针对伊朗的攻击，即使这会惹恼美国。

sentences.en: And it means having the strength to stand firm by our values and our principles, no matter the pressure to do otherwise.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要有力量坚定地捍卫我们的价值观和原则，无论面临多大的压力。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the fighting raged on.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，战斗仍在继续。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: military said it was finding and destroying Iran's mobile missile launchers, while Iran struck pro-American Kurdish forces in Iraq,
sentences.zh: 军方称正在搜寻并摧毁伊朗的移动导弹发射器，而伊朗则打击了伊拉克境内的亲美库尔德武装，

sentences.en: who are seen as allies in America's plan to overthrow the Iranian regime.
sentences.zh: 这些人被视为美国推翻伊朗政权计划中的盟友。

sentences.en: Finally, Iran's foreign minister accused the U.S.
sentences.zh: 最后，伊朗外交部长指责美国

sentences.en: of committing a, quote, atrocity at war by sinking an Iranian warship off the coast of Sri Lanka on Wednesday and killing many of the sailors on board.
sentences.zh: 犯下了所谓的战争暴行，周三在斯里兰卡海岸击沉了一艘伊朗军舰，造成船上许多船员死亡。

sentences.zh: 这艘船在被击中时距离冲突地区有数千英里远。
